body: 把上传合成人物照片转成书架上的摇头娃娃，明显放大头部、细弹簧颈、身体卡通化。保留短黑发、红圆眼镜、脸部特征、黄外套与青绿裤。完整娃娃站在小圆底座，真实书架和模糊书脊，暖光，无可读文字。3:4。

en.body:
## How to use

Copy the exact prompt used for this image. Changing the subject creates a new, untested variant. Upload the ordered synthetic reference images shown in the run before generating.

## Observed result

An oversized recognizable head and exposed spring neck distinguish the bobblehead, with reference colors retained on a bookshelf.

## Source

Independently adapted from the supplied design prompt collection, case 51. [Source](https://github.com/jamez-bondos/awesome-gpt4o-images/blob/main/README_en.md). GPT Image returned no precise version identifier.
